While it may take you an extra half an hour, the benefit to the organization in terms of information integrity and support readiness outweighs personal convenience, especially considering you're handling your own clients. If you find the template cumbersome, a review of its layout to streamline it further might be warranted, ensuring it’s usable without sacrificing the benefits it generates.
high_response: I understand that filling out the template takes extra time, but sticking to it is important for keeping everything organized and ensuring that everyone can track incidents effectively across departments. By following the standard process, we help maintain clear communication and accountability, which ultimately supports the whole team. I recommend that you go ahead and use the template this week; the slight extra time is a worthwhile investment in our overall workflow.
